narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>There are thirteen years and four columns, so I add, thirteen plus four, seventeen bars.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>One cluster alone already has four bars in it.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Thirteen clusters must hold far more than seventeen.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Count the clusters, with both end years included.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then multiply by the columns in each cluster.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. A graph runs from two thousand and ten to two thousand and nineteen. Each year has three columns. How many bars?
